- **Build modern React and TypeScript applications using AI-assisted engineering workflows**
- **Multiple opportunities | 12-month contract + 12-month extension option**
- **Australian Citizenship required | Ability to obtain Baseline clearance**

Join a multidisciplinary digital delivery team developing accessible, secure and user-centred web applications within a large-scale enterprise environment.

This is a hands-on frontend engineering role with a strong emphasis on AI-assisted software development. You'll combine your expertise in React and TypeScript with modern AI development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining ownership of code quality, security, accessibility and technical outcomes.

**The Role**

Working closely with designers, business analysts, architects and backend developers, you'll contribute to the development and ongoing improvement of modern digital applications.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Developing, testing and maintaining modern web applications using React and TypeScript
- Leveraging AI-assisted development tools throughout implementation, testing, debugging and documentation
- Developing reusable components, enhancing design systems and integrating frontend applications with backend services
- Ensuring applications meet accessibility, security, performance and maintainability standards
- Contributing to code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD processes and continuous improvement of engineering practices

**About You**

We're particularly interested in:

- Strong hands-on frontend development experience using React and TypeScript
- Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, API integration and responsive UI development
- Demonstrated experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day software engineering workflows
- Ability to effectively direct, review, validate and refine AI-generated code, backed by strong software engineering fundamentals
- Experience delivering accessible digital applications and applying inclusive design principles throughout development
- Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
- Strong communication and collaboration skills within multidisciplinary delivery teams
- Experience with agentic development tools, specification-driven development, component libraries or cloud-native platforms would be highly regarded

**Why Consider the Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity to work within an engineering environment where AI-assisted development is a core part of how software is delivered, rather than an optional productivity tool.

You'll have the opportunity to further develop your capabilities across emerging AI engineering workflows while remaining hands-on with React and TypeScript, applying these approaches to complex enterprise applications where accessibility, security and code quality remain essential.

For a confidential discussion, contact Jaela Smith at Talent International on 0480 806 146 or jaela.smith@talentinternational.com.

Senior React Native Developer – Mobile Apps
results.description:
**Role summary:** Technical anchor for the mobile squad onsite. Builds and ships high-quality Android and iOS apps in React Native, works directly with client product owners, and guides the offshore developer and tester.

**Key responsibilities**

- Design, build and maintain cross-platform features in React Native for Android and iOS
- Turn client requirements into technical designs, estimates, and user stories with the product owner
- Lead code reviews, set coding standards and mentor the offshore team
- Integrate with REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication, push notifications, analytics, and device features
- Own app performance, accessibility, security, and stability (crash-free rate, app size, start-up time)
- Manage builds and releases to the Apple App Store and Google Play

**Core skills**

- React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, React hooks, state management (Redux, Zustand or similar)
- Native modules and bridging; working knowledge of Swift/Kotlin, Xcode and Android Studio
- Unit and component testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library)
- Mobile UI/UX patterns, offline storage, deep linking, responsive layouts

**Modern engineering baseline**

- **Cloud:** working knowledge of AWS or Azure services used by mobile back ends (API gateways, serverless functions, storage, identity e.g., Cognito/Entra ID); Firebase
- **Dev tools:** Git and branching strategies, Jira/Confluence, debugging and profiling tools (Flipper, React DevTools, Xcode Instruments)
- **AI dev tools:** hands-on use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or similar) for code generation, refactoring, test writing, and review, with sound judgement on quality and security of AI output
- **DevOps:** mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Bitrise or Codemagic), Fastlane, code signing, OTA updates (Expo EAS / CodePush), crash monitoring (Sentry, Crashlytics)

**Nice to have:** Expo, insurance or financial-services apps, Agile/Scrum leadership, experience working with offshore teams

**Soft skills:** strong client communication, ownership, and the ability to coach others
